procedure.method: I read the explicitly pinned packet, case, review rules, rubric, ratio policy and helper code, and read all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following embedded paths. Python standard-library SHA-256, byte-length and PNG IHDR checks verified the declared exact files and native/view dimensions. There are no supplied source assets or protected-layout manifests. I used view_image with detail='original', forwarding each returned image as original-detail image content, in native → usage720 → thumbnail320 order within M1 → M2 → M3 → M4 → M5. All 15 exact views returned and were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, image score or diversity score. First raw reads were retained separately and compared with the predeclared normalization. No ambiguity revisit was needed or performed. This is a viewing attestation, not a claim about trace serialization; the runner owns session provenance.
